ai_summary: Bandhan Bank Limited has formally announced the appointment of Mr. Vinay Jain as its Interim Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), effective September 26, 2026, until March 31, 2027. The interim nature of this critical leadership position suggests a temporary arrangement, indicating a period of transition as the bank likely seeks a permanent appointment. This update also provides a revised list of KMPs authorized for making material regulatory disclosures.
